title: OpenMind object event
description: Telemetry or event of an object, published on openmind/v1/events. data is free-form and typed by (object, kind).

object.description: Object id, e.g. robot, twin, bird.

kind.description: Event kind, e.g. telemetry, collision, stopped.

ts.description: Unix time in seconds (UTC) when the message was created.
